name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog 确认对话框
description: 打断用户、要求确认的对话框，用于不可撤销或重要的操作。

whenToUse: 删除、覆盖、发布等不可撤销操作前确认
accessibility: 点击遮罩不会关闭，必须明确选择
responsive: 窄屏下按钮纵向排列，主操作在最下方便于拇指点击

files.content:
# Alert Dialog 设计规范

- 只用于需要用户明确确认的操作，如删除、覆盖、放弃未保存的修改；普通表单和内容用 Dialog，操作结果的通知用 Sonner。
- 必须有 `AlertDialog.Title` 和 `AlertDialog.Description`：标题直接问要做的事（“删除这个项目？”），说明写清后果以及能否撤销（检查规则 `valar/overlay-title`）。
- 必须有 `AlertDialog.Cancel`：点击遮罩不会关闭，用户只能按 Esc 或点按钮离开（检查规则 `valar/alert-dialog-cancel`）。
- 普通确认和 `appearance="confirmation"` 使用同一套 480 px 宽、12 px 圆角、20 px 内边距和透明底操作栏。丢弃草稿或删除时可通过 `focusCancel` 把初始焦点放在安全操作上。传入 `onOpenAutoFocus` 时仍可自行指定焦点。
- 对照 Linear 删除确认时可用 `appearance="danger"` 与 `variant="destructive"`。弹窗最大宽 480 px，圆角 12 px，水平留白 24 px，操作按钮高 32 px。危险按钮两主题均用 `lch(58% 73 29)`。
- 按钮文字写具体动作（“删除”“放弃修改”），不要写“确定”“是”。危险操作的 `AlertDialog.Action` 设 `variant="destructive"`；Action 和 Cancel 的尺寸只用 `size` 属性（检查规则 `valar/button-size-via-prop`）。
- `AlertDialog.Action` 的业务操作成功后通过 `bind:open` 关闭。异步操作期间可用 `loading` 阻止重复触发并保留焦点，配合文案和 Spinner。失败时保留对话框并就地提供错误原因和重试。
- 按钮放在 `AlertDialog.Footer`。普通确认把 Cancel 放在主操作前；草稿确认把次要的丢弃动作放在 Cancel 前。窄屏时按原有顺序换行。
- 简短的确认用 `<AlertDialog.Content size="sm">`；需要图标时放进 `AlertDialog.Media`，不要自己写带颜色的图标容器。
- 打开它的按钮通过 `AlertDialog.Trigger` 的 `child` snippet 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		buttonVariants,
		type ButtonVariant,
		type ButtonSize,
	} from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		type = "button",
		variant = "default",
		size = "default",
		loading = false,
		onclick,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		variant?: ButtonVariant;
		size?: ButtonSize;
		/** Blocks repeat activation and retains keyboard focus while an action is pending. */
		loading?: boolean;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	function handleClick(
		event: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }
	) {
		if (loading || restProps["aria-disabled"] === true || restProps["aria-disabled"] === "true") {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
			return;
		}
		onclick?.(event);
	}
</script>

{#if child}
	{@render child({
		props: {
			...restProps,
			type,
			"data-slot": "alert-dialog-action",
			"data-variant": variant,
			"data-loading": loading ? "" : undefined,
			"aria-busy": loading ? true : restProps["aria-busy"],
			"aria-disabled": loading ? true : restProps["aria-disabled"],
			class: cn(
				buttonVariants({ variant, size, shape: "pill" }),
				"min-w-0 max-w-full whitespace-normal [overflow-wrap:anywhere] dark:duration-150 data-loading:cursor-wait data-loading:pointer-events-none",
				className
			),
			onclick: handleClick,
		},
	})}
{:else}
	<button
		bind:this={ref}
		{type}
		data-slot="alert-dialog-action"
		data-variant={variant}
		class={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, shape: "pill" }), "min-w-0 max-w-full whitespace-normal [overflow-wrap:anywhere] dark:duration-150 data-loading:cursor-wait data-loading:pointer-events-none", className)}
		{...restProps}
		aria-busy={loading ? true : restProps["aria-busy"]}
		aria-disabled={loading ? true : restProps["aria-disabled"]}
		data-loading={loading ? "" : undefined}
		onclick={handleClick}
	>
		{@render children?.()}
	</button>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { DialogClose as SdkClose } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import {
		buttonVariants,
		type ButtonVariant,

	} from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		type = "button",
		variant = "outline",
		size = "default",
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "value"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		variant?: ButtonVariant;
		size?: ButtonSize;
		value?: string;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkClose
	{type}
	data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"
	data-variant={variant}
	class={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, shape: "pill" }), "min-w-0 max-w-full whitespace-normal [overflow-wrap:anywhere] [--valar-button-outline-base:white] dark:[--valar-button-outline-base:lch(13.861%_1.139_272)]", className)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "alert-dialog-cancel",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkClose>

	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		DialogTrigger as SdkTrigger,
		type DialogController,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		type = "button",
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		payload,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		payload?: unknown;
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{type}
	disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{payload}
	{shortcut}
	{controller}
	data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger"
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "alert-dialog-trigger",
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Dialog as SdkDialog,
		type DialogController,
		type DialogDismissAttemptDetails,
		type DialogOpenChangeDetails,
		type DialogPayloadChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import {
		ALERT_DIALOG_POLICY_KEY,
		type AlertDialogDismissPolicy,
	} from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(false),
		defaultOpen,
		controller,
		dismissible,
		persistentElements,
		pendingAnnouncement,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		persistentElements?: (Element | string)[] | (() => Element[]);
		pendingAnnouncement?: string;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: DialogOpenChangeDetails) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<DialogPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DialogDismissAttemptDetails) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<AlertDialogDismissPolicy>({});
	const effectiveModal = $derived(policy.trapFocus === false ? false : true);
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	const closeOnOutsidePress = $derived(
		policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "close" ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-close"
	);

	setContext(ALERT_DIALOG_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: AlertDialogDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
		isOpen: () => Boolean(open),
		isModal: () => effectiveModal,
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: DialogOpenChangeDetails) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				details.reason === "outside-press" &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === undefined ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkDialog
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={effectiveModal}
	{closeOnOutsidePress}
	presentation="dialog"
	{controller}
	{dismissible}
	{persistentElements}
	{pendingAnnouncement}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkDialog>
